Dataset description

This dataset contains transactional sales order data covering multiple years. Each row represents a single order line, capturing sales value, profit, quantity, product classification, customer details, geographic location, payment method, and order timing. the dataset has 1,194 rows, no missing values, no duplicates

column3: Unique identifier for each sales order. Can repeat across rows if orders contain multiple items.
Date the order was placed. Used for time-based analysis (monthly, yearly trends).
Name of the customer who placed the order.
City where the customer or order destination is located.
State or region of the customer or order destination.
Detailed product classification within each category.
Method used to complete the transaction (e.g. COD, Online).
Number of units sold in the order line.
Total sales value for the order line.
Profit generated from the order line. Can be negative.
Pre-aggregated year-month label derived from Order Date. Redundant once a proper date table is used.
